operations.description: Sonicate ITO sequentially in acetone, ethanol and DI water (30 min each). Affix 9 mm diameter, 1.8 mm thick sticky chamber; dry 200 µL PVP-AgNS solution (OD 80 at 1 cm) at 60 °C. Remove chamber and wash with DI water, ethanol, isopropanol. Resulting AgNS film coverage is 5.2%.

quality.review_scope: Independent scoped quick audit accepted main PDF pp.1–6 and selected SI pp.1–3,5–8 for the packaged Ag nanosphere, control and QD-film outcomes. Main pp.7–8, SI p.4 and cited upstream green/red QD syntheses remain outside this accepted scope; this is not a complete-paper Reader.
missing_fields: Green/red QD syntheses are cited prior work and not reconstructed; QD spin speed, time, solution concentration and volume are unreported.
Cu(I) control reagent/quantity and acetonitrile-water ratio are unreported; unetched AgNP-film control conditions are not independently specified.
AgNS atomic coordinates, exact single-twinned boundary geometry and source-figure reuse permission are unavailable.
The 460/580 µL size-series variants lack independently reported non-Cu reaction settings; SI Figure S8 plots rather than prints exact dose-to-diameter pairs.
conflicts: Main p.2 reports 67% AgNC and 33% right bipyramid after flocculation; SI Figure S1c labels 66.98% and 32.02%, which sum to 99.00%. Preserve source statements without normalization.
SI Figure S10 caption describes green (c) and red (d) PL distributions, but the artwork labels these panels b and c; sample links follow visible panels and note the caption error.
